An ignored visual headline

Storage limits are not a housekeeping detail when terminal records are evidence used by recovery logic. A cleanup policy that deletes evidence too early can turn a resolvable crash into a permanent ambiguous state.

The safe window includes detection latency, reconciliation cadence, timeout budget, and the longest supported recovery outage. Monitoring must warn while enough evidence still exists to act.

By treating the retention equation as configuration validation, the application refuses combinations that cannot meet its own recovery contract.
